comments.author: CaliCaddy
comments.body:
Prevents the occurrence of scurvy, malnutrition and plague when there are water and food in cargo, and reduces the consumption of water and food.

Required to build:
Shipbuilding 5

Required skill to use:
Navigation 3
Management Technique 3

Required parts:
Original Ship Permit x1
Galley x1
Special Ship Hold x1
